title: Watch: Air Force Chief grooves to Garba beats, joins Navratri celebrations in Gujarat - Moneycontrol.com
full_text:
Indian Air Force Chief Air Chief Marshal A P Singh joined the Garba celebrations at a Navratri event in Vadodara, Gujarat, where he was seen trying a few dance steps to the festive music.
A video circulating on social media shows Singh enjoying the celebrations at the third night of the United Way of Baroda Navratri Garba Mahotsav 2026.
Dressed in blue traditional attire with a dupatta, he participated in the popular Gujarati dance form along with other attendees.
The annual event attracts thousands of people during Navratri. Singh was accompanied by an organising committee member and a security guard while taking part in the celebrations.
The video received positive reactions online, with several users appreciating the Air Force Chief’s participation and calling his Garba moves charming.
Other senior defence officials, including Air Marshal P V Shivanand, Air Commodore R S Bhandari and retired Air Marshal Sunil Kashinath Vidhate, also attended the event with their families, according to a report by NDTV.
